item.title: Ukraine reconstruction cost estimate raised to $588B by World Bank
item.description: The updated cost is nearly three times the GDP of Ukraine, up from $524 billion, with a focus on housing, energy, education, transportation and other essential sectors.

item.title: Croatian president halts military cooperation with Israel over 'unacceptable conduct'
item.description: President Milanovic cites 'unprecedented violations of international humanitarian law' as defence minister signals continued industry ties.

item.title: Türkiye in joint statement condemns Israel's expanding control over occupied West Bank
item.description: The joint statement rejects Israel's measures aimed at reshaping the demographic composition and status of occupied Palestinian territory since 1967, including East Jerusalem.

item.title: US says 'everything is on the table' as Washington presses Iran on nuclear deal
item.description: 'Our job is to provide options, and we will have options for the president should Iran decide not to take a deal,' Pete Hegseth says.

item.title: After 'El Mencho' killing, fear grips Mexico's tourist heartland in lead up to FIFA World Cup
item.description: As fighting between the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and Mexican security forces rage on in a number of states, fears are growing that there will be more violence to come.

item.title: South Korea's ex-president appeals life sentence over martial law decree
item.description: A local court handed a life sentence last week to Yoon Suk-yeol for leading an insurrection in connection with his attempt to impose martial law in December 2024.

item.title: China slaps export curbs on Japanese firms over military ties
item.description: Beijing targets 40 Japanese companies, including Mitsubishi Heavy Industries subsidiaries, with dual-use export restrictions.

item.title: US forces not involved in cartel leader takedown: Mexican president
item.description: The US only provided intelligence to the Mexican government before an operation that resulted in the killing of a powerful cartel leader 'El Mencho', says President Claudia Sheinbaum.

item.title: Cartel boss killing sparks violence in Mexico
item.description: Mexican security forces have reportedly killed El Mencho, the head of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG), in a military operation. Following the reported killing, violence has escalated across several states

item.title: Selective allocation of emotional resources
item.description: The tendency to feel empathy for certain people while overlooking others. Closeness, perceived similarity, media coverage and the stories we hear shape who receives our emotional attention
